title: Minecraft Render Pipeline
description:
A distributed system for a Minecraft creative server.

A player requests a render of their build in game; the pipeline turns the world region into a 3D scene, renders images and video and posts the result to Discord.

What I built:
— A game-server plugin that sends jobs to a central control service
— One-shot workers in containers for world conversion, headless 3D rendering and media compression
— Retries and duplicate-safe delivery when a network call fails halfway

The code is closed-source; I'm happy to walk through the architecture on a call.
